Alan / Grace — quick technical notes ahead of the demo:
- Deterministic hashing with a customer-specific salt is feasible. We can provide a small client-side library (or an ingest-time transform) that hashes Trace IDs with HMAC-SHA256 and stores only the first 16 hex characters to limit surface while preserving uniqueness for correlation.
- For MRNs and SSNs: recommend structured redaction rules + regex fallback. For SSNs we propose canonical tokenization (replace with <SSN_REDACTED>).
- Headers: we can suppress or hash selected headers (e.g., cookie, authorization) at ingest. We support pattern-based rules (path, header name, JSON keys).
- Sample size: send 20–50 lines including a couple of repeated trace IDs so I can validate correlation behavior.

I'll prepare two short config examples: one that runs entirely at ingest (no client change) and one with optional client-side masking if you prefer not to send raw traces even transiently.
